name: harness-ownloop-vs-hermes-haiku
title: Draft stand-in: own loop vs Hermes on Claude Haiku 5.5 (15 draft tasks, one trial each)
description: A small draft run, shipped as a stand-in until the real experiment is run and exported on Friday 6 Nov. Arm A is the own plain loop and arm B is Hermes, both on Claude Haiku 5.5 with the finance-advisor v1 prompt and the finance tools, over 15 draft tasks (10 single prompts, 5 simulated-client conversations). One trial per task and arm: 30 real trials, all done, $0.14 of model spend. It was the first label batch, run for open coding, not a powered comparison, so its pass counts show what the platform records, not which harness is better. Only the rule-based graders ran: the LLM judge was not approved for it, so 20 of the 30 trials are incomplete (a required judge grade is missing).
experiment_name: Label batch 1: open coding (R8, approved: 30 trials, cap $2)
approximations: rows assembled from an API without GET /experiments/:id/bundle; every content hash (tasks, prompts, toolsets, capabilities) was checked against the catalogue files it came from
grading_jobs: only each trial's latest finished job; its graders and grader_files are empty, claims is 1, worker_id, claimed_at and lease_until are null (that API does not serve them)
grades: spec_sha256 null; framework_version and job_id are the job's
experiments: cancelled_at, resumed_at and spend_guard_at from the events list
trials: seq rebuilt from the plan order (repeat, task, config), reported_at = finished_at, keys_revoked_at null
prompts, toolsets and tasks: first_seen_at is the load time
